Change one setting (admins only) unless it changed since that revision (RFC 9110).

The change is audited; the response's `ETag` names the new revision.

412.description: The setting changed since that revision

412.description: The setting changed since that revision

409.description: No SECRETS_KEY to encrypt the key with

409.description: The service lists its models for a valid key only

502.description: The service did not list its models

get.description:
Every job's runs, newest first (admins only): of one job, status or trigger if asked.

A full page means older runs may follow: ask again with `before` the last one's ID.

How the runs listed ended over time (admins only): for the Job runs chart.

The runs the same filters list, scheduled from `start` until `end` (default: the last 7
calendar days, today included), counted per hour for up to 2 days, else per calendar day,
in `timezone` (the client's, an IANA name). Only runs that ended count; "failed" means
failed for good.

422.description: A start after the end, or more than a year between

post.description:
Queue a run of `job` now (admins only). It runs like a scheduled one: leased, retried.

One manual run per job at a time: while one is queued or running, it is returned. Sent
with an `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID per click), the request can be repeated, e.g. after its
answer was lost: it gets the same run, even once that run has finished.

get.description:
The job's runs, newest first (admins only): failures, retries, who ran when.

A full page means older runs may follow: ask again with `before` the last one's ID.
The job's run under way, scheduled or manual, if any: the job's page follows it.

How the job's runs ended lately (admins only): for the run health tiles and overview.

Counts for the last 24 hours, the last 7 days, and each of the last 7 calendar days in
`timezone` (the client's, an IANA name).

Runs count by when they finished. "Failed" means failed for good: a run waiting for its
retry has not finished yet.
A run's progress (admins only), e.g. of one they queued.

post.description:
Add a Feed (admins only): the next scrape reads it. Its slug comes from its name.

The kind must be one InfraSales reads; its Lister checks the settings. Adding is audited.

409.description: A Feed has that address already

delete.description:
Delete a Feed that has collected no Sources yet (admins only), e.g. one added by mistake.

A Feed with Sources stays: the catalog keeps where each Source came from. Deleting is audited.

post.description:
Suggest the Feed to add for a site (admins only): its feed, else its sitemap.

Looks at the page's feed links, usual feed paths and the sitemaps robots.txt names,
obeying robots.txt and pausing between requests, for at most 20 seconds. Nothing is stored.

422.description: The address is not allowed or not readable, or offers no Feed

504.description: The site did not answer in time

get.description:
Which Feeds list the same documents (admins only): each Feed's own share, the top pairs.

Summed over the Source Collection runs that finished in the last `days` days (at most the
newest 1000), in listings: an address counts once in each run that lists it.

The collected Sources, newest change first (admins only), filtered.

Each is listed by its latest version, or by the one `run` wrote. `feed` and `category` may
be given several times; `q` matches the title or the address; `since` and `until` bound when
the listed version was fetched (its last change). A full page means older ones may follow:
ask again with `before` the last one's `version.id`.

post.description: Serve the forecast with this model (admins only): a forecast run is queued at once.

get.description: The company's best chances: open tenders in reach, then municipalities expected to tender.
The company's profile: the names it wins under, the work it does, its sites.

post.description:
Import the company's own bids as CSV: all of them, or none and the errors why.

Columns: ref, title, submitted_on, outcome (won, lost, pending, withdrawn), and if known
buyer_name, value_eur, rank, offers, winning_value_eur. With `own_model`, they calibrate the
company's own chances (Modell B).

Hours for up to 2 days, else calendar days: oldest first. Runs that have not ended yet
count in neither.

Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.description:
When a job runs: on these weekdays, at this local time (daily means all seven days).

With `every_hours`, it also runs every that many hours after the time, until the day ends:
`00:00` every 3 hours is 00:00, 03:00, ..., 21:00 (like systemd's `00/3` or cron's `0 */3`).
